title: Kassandra IDI's Latest Single, "Good" - Controlled Anger Expressed Through Soulful R&B
htmlContent:
Kassandra IDI, the talented singer-songwriter, producer, and social scientist, has just released her latest single, "Good." The song expresses that it is possible to feel anger yet control it and not act upon it.

As a millennial artist with a unique alternative R&B sound, Kassandra IDI's emotional intelligence and critical thinking shine through in her music. Her ability to connect with the listener through her powerful voice and relatable lyrics is a testament to her skill as a songwriter.

Born in Paris to parents of DR Congo descent, Kassandra IDI was raised in different cities across Europe before settling in London. She sings in English, French, and Lingala, reflecting her multicultural background.

"Good" is just one of many exciting releases from Kassandra IDI this year. Fans can look forward to more singles, an EP, and video series on social media exploring music and artistry.
